items.description: Signed LB Germaine Pratt to the practice squad.
Signed QB Brady Cook to the practice squad. Released RB Jarquez Hunter from the practice squad.
Signed WR Jamaal Pritchett to the practice squad. Released WR Tyler Johnson from the practice squad.

Placed DT Cam Jackson on injured reserve. Designated RB Trevor Etienne, RT Taylor Moton and DT Tershawn Wharton to return from injured lists. Signed CB Robert Rochell to the practice squad. Released OLB Cam Gill from the practice squad.

Signed CB Anthony Kendall from the practice squad to the active roster. Released OLB Michael Danna. Elevated DT Phidarian Mathis and WR Trent Sherfield Sr. from the practice squad to the active roster.
Released LB Jonathan Garvin from injured reserve.
Claimed LB Jack Kiser off waivers from Jacksonville. Placed LB Swayze Bozeman on injured reserve.
Released C Nick Leverett.
Signed WR Jamari Thrash to the practice squad. Placed WR Tyler Scott on the practice squad/injured list.
Traded WR Marvin Harrison Jr. and a 2027 sixth-round draft pick to Houston for 2027 second- and seventh-round draft picks.
Designated WR David Sills V to return from injured reserve.
Signed DT Keith Cooper Jr. to the practice squad. Released DE Anthony Goodlow from the practice squad.
Waived WR Jared Wayne.
Placed LB Yasir Abdullah on injured reserve. Signed S Jammie Robinson from the practice squad. Elevated LBs Drake Jackson and Bralen Trice from the practice squad.
Activated LB Noah Sewell from the physically unable to perform list. Reinstated LB Noah Sewell from the PUP list.
Elevated DB Russ Yeast from the practice squad.
Elevated DTs Sam Kamara and Chris Williams from the practice squad.
Elevated DBs Brent Austin and Sean Fresch from the practice squad.
Elevated DB Jalen Mills from the practice squad.
Placed RB Chris Brooks on injured reserve. Signed RB Pierre Strong to their active roster.
Elevated RB Kalel Mullings and DB Isaiah Oliver from the practice squad.
Elevated WR Nick Westbrook-Ikhine from the practice squad. Placed DE Arden Key on injured reserve.
Elevated RB Roman Hemby and WR Deven Thompkins from the practice squad.
Reinstated DT Kenneth Grant from injured reserve. Waived QB Brady Cook. Elevated DE Rodney McGraw and RB Carlos Washington from the practice squad.
Reinstated C Michael Jurgens and TE Ben Yurosek from injured reserve. Elevated WRs Odell Beckham and Jeshaun Jones from the practice squad.
